name: 03-virtual-machines
title: The seven virtual machines
description: Provision the seven-VM estate on the physical host from the noble cloud image: per-VM qcow2 disks, cloud-init seeds carrying identity + the lab SSH key + the fixed .99 static addressing, OSD data disks for the three Ceph nodes, virt-install with host-passthrough, then wait for first boots, push estate name resolution to every VM, and prove SSH, hostnames and the jumbo-frame path.
source: Generated from runbooks/lab/lab-vms.yaml in the MatrixClaw lab repository. That runbook built this phase of the real 32 GB estate on 20-21 July 2026; the run records hold every command's exit code and output.
honesty: Steps change this machine and are gated. Each carries an 'already' probe, so a re-run skips what is done rather than repeating it. Checks are read-only and carry exact-match markers so they cannot pass on their own error text.

steps.title: Clear stale host keys
steps.run: for ip in 11 21 22 23 31 32 41; do ssh-keygen -R 10.100.99.$ip >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done && echo HOST-KEYS-CLEARED
steps.already: test -z "$(for ip in 11 21 22 23 31 32 41; do ssh-keygen -F 10.100.99.$ip 2>/dev/null; done)"

steps.title: Write build script
steps.run:
tee ~/build-lab-vms.sh > /dev/null << 'OUTER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system

BASE=/data/iso/noble-server-cloudimg-amd64.img
DIR=/data/lab
PUBKEY=$(cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub)

# name        vcpus ram(MB) disk(GB) osd_disks networks (in NIC order)
PLAN="
mgmt-01      {{mgmt_vcpus}}  {{mgmt_ram}} 100 0 lab-mgmt
ceph-01      {{ceph_vcpus}}  {{ceph_ram}}  40 2 lab-mgmt,lab-storage-fe,lab-storage-be
ceph-02      {{ceph_vcpus}}  {{ceph_ram}}  40 2 lab-mgmt,lab-storage-fe,lab-storage-be
ceph-03      {{ceph_vcpus}}  {{ceph_ram}}  40 2 lab-mgmt,lab-storage-fe,lab-storage-be
kvm-01       {{kvm_vcpus}}  {{kvm_ram}} 100 0 lab-mgmt,lab-storage-fe,lab-guest,lab-public
kvm-02       {{kvm_vcpus}}  {{kvm_ram}} 100 0 lab-mgmt,lab-storage-fe,lab-guest,lab-public
nfs-01       {{nfs_vcpus}}  {{nfs_ram}} 200 0 lab-mgmt
"

ip_suffix() {  # last octet per VM name
  case $1 in
    mgmt-01) echo 11;; ceph-01) echo 21;; ceph-02) echo 22;; ceph-03) echo 23;;
    kvm-01)  echo 31;; kvm-02)  echo 32;; nfs-01)  echo 41;;
  esac
}

echo "$PLAN" | while read -r NAME VCPUS RAM DISK OSDS NETS; do
  [ -z "${NAME:-}" ] && continue
  N=$(ip_suffix "$NAME")
  echo "=== Building ${NAME} (10.100.99.${N}) ==="

  # Disk: full copy of the base image, resized (cloud-init grows the fs)
  qemu-img convert -O qcow2 "$BASE" "$DIR/${NAME}.qcow2"
  qemu-img resize "$DIR/${NAME}.qcow2" "${DISK}G"

  # cloud-init seed
  WORK=$(mktemp -d)
  printf 'instance-id: %s\nlocal-hostname: %s\n' "$NAME" "$NAME" > "$WORK/meta-data"

  cat > "$WORK/user-data" << UD
#cloud-config
users:
  - name: labadmin
    shell: /bin/bash
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ${PUBKEY}
      - {{deployer_pubkey}}
ssh_pwauth: true
package_update: true
packages: [qemu-guest-agent, chrony]
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
UD

  # Static addressing, per-interface, in NIC order
  {
    echo "version: 2"
    echo "ethernets:"
    echo "  enp1s0:"
    echo "    addresses: [10.100.99.${N}/24]"
    echo "    routes: [{to: default, via: 10.100.99.1}]"
    echo "    nameservers: {addresses: [1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8]}"
    if [[ "$NETS" == *lab-storage-fe* ]]; then
      echo "  enp2s0:"
      echo "    addresses: [10.200.99.${N}/24]"
      echo "    mtu: 9000"
    fi
    if [[ "$NETS" == *lab-storage-be* ]]; then
      echo "  enp3s0:"
      echo "    addresses: [10.201.99.${N}/24]"
      echo "    mtu: 9000"
    fi
  } > "$WORK/network-config"

  cloud-localds --network-config="$WORK/network-config" \
      "$DIR/${NAME}-seed.iso" "$WORK/user-data" "$WORK/meta-data"
  rm -rf "$WORK"

  # OSD data disks for the Ceph nodes
  DISK_ARGS=()
  for i in $(seq 1 "$OSDS"); do
    qemu-img create -f qcow2 "$DIR/${NAME}-osd${i}.qcow2" 50G
    DISK_ARGS+=(--disk "path=$DIR/${NAME}-osd${i}.qcow2,format=qcow2,bus=virtio")
  done

  NET_ARGS=()
  IFS=',' read -ra NLIST <<< "$NETS"
  for net in "${NLIST[@]}"; do NET_ARGS+=(--network "network=${net},model=virtio"); done

  virt-install --name "$NAME" --memory "$RAM" --vcpus "$VCPUS" \
    --cpu host-passthrough \
    --disk "path=$DIR/${NAME}.qcow2,format=qcow2,bus=virtio" \
    "${DISK_ARGS[@]}" \
    --disk "path=$DIR/${NAME}-seed.iso,device=cdrom" \
    "${NET_ARGS[@]}" \
    --osinfo ubuntu24.04 --import --graphics none \
    --noautoconsole --autostart
done

echo; echo "All seven VMs defined and booting:"; virsh list
OUTER
chmod +x ~/build-lab-vms.sh

steps.title: Build estate
steps.destroys: the disks of all seven estate virtual machines, overwriting each from the base cloud image. Everything inside them is lost. There is no undo and Nano takes no backup.

steps.title: Wait first boot
steps.run:
ok=0
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  ok=1
  for ip in 11 21 22 23 31 32 41; do
    ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=5 \
        labadmin@10.100.99.$ip true 2>/dev/null || ok=0
  done
  [ $ok -eq 1 ] && break
  sleep 10
done
[ $ok -eq 1 ] && echo ESTATE-UP || { echo 'FATAL: not all seven VMs answered SSH within 10 minutes - virsh console <name> shows the boot'; exit 1; }

steps.title: Estate name resolution
steps.run:
HOSTS_BLOCK='
# CloudStack lab estate
10.100.99.11 mgmt-01
10.100.99.21 ceph-01
10.100.99.22 ceph-02
10.100.99.23 ceph-03
10.100.99.31 kvm-01
10.100.99.32 kvm-02
10.100.99.41 nfs-01'

for ip in 11 21 22 23 31 32 41; do
  echo "$HOSTS_BLOCK" | ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.$ip \
    "grep -q 'CloudStack lab estate' /etc/hosts || sudo tee -a /etc/hosts > /dev/null"
done
echo HOSTS-PUSHED
steps.already: for ip in 11 21 22 23 31 32 41; do ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.$ip "grep -q 'CloudStack lab estate' /etc/hosts" || exit 1; done

checks.title: Seven vms running
checks.run: export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system; test "$(virsh list --name | grep -cE '^(mgmt-01|ceph-0[123]|kvm-0[12]|nfs-01)$')" -eq 7 && echo SEVEN-VMS-RUNNING

checks.title: Estate hostnames answer
checks.run: for ip in 11 21 22 23 31 32 41; do ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new labadmin@10.100.99.$ip hostname; done | tr '\n' ' '
checks.expect_output: mgmt-01 ceph-01 ceph-02 ceph-03 kvm-01 kvm-02 nfs-01

checks.title: Jumbo frame path
checks.run: ssh -o BatchMode=yes labadmin@10.100.99.21 'ping -M do -s 8972 -c 3 10.200.99.22 -I 10.200.99.21' >/dev/null && echo JUMBO-OK
